name: assessmentselection
sql:
CREATE TABLE assessmentselection (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER, 
	content_revision_id INTEGER, 
	content_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	item_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	approval VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	judge_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	assisted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	hints_used INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revealed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id INTEGER, 
	arena_attempt_id INTEGER, 
	interview_question_id INTEGER, 
	result_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_revision_id) REFERENCES contentrevision (id), 
	UNIQUE (attempt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES attempt (id), 
	UNIQUE (arena_attempt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(arena_attempt_id) REFERENCES arenaattempt (id), 
	UNIQUE (interview_question_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(interview_question_id) REFERENCES interviewquestion (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_open_topic_context ON assessmentselection (topic_id, purpose) WHERE status='open' AND purpose IN ('practice','transfer','recall')

name: evidencecredit
sql:
CREATE TABLE evidencecredit (
	selection_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	event_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	global_key VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (selection_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_assessment_credit UNIQUE (topic_id, family, purpose), 
	FOREIGN KEY(selection_id) REFERENCES assessmentselection (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	UNIQUE (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES masteryevidenceevent (id), 
	UNIQUE (global_key)
)

name: evidencepolicyrecord
sql:
CREATE TABLE evidencepolicyrecord (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	previous_projection_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: assessmenthelpevent
sql:
CREATE TABLE assessmenthelpevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	selection_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(selection_id) REFERENCES assessmentselection (id)
)
